label: comma join
sql: SELECT a.id FROM a, b WHERE a.id = b.a_id LIMIT 10

label: wildcard
sql: SELECT id FROM users WHERE email LIKE '%@example.com' LIMIT 10

label: clean parameterized
sql: SELECT id, email FROM users WHERE id = $1 LIMIT 1

label: clean read-only join
sql: SELECT u.id FROM users u JOIN teams t ON t.id = u.team_id WHERE u.id = $1 LIMIT 1
